fusions.name: Staple Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a heavy staple that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance per hit to leave it [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shutter Slam
fusions.desc: Slams a mail-hung shutter round you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Linked Hauberk
fusions.desc: Links a barrier of mail that absorbs the next 28 damage and raises your armour by 15% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Riveted Lining
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
